question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3,'** i.e. **"an"**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that follows the blank is **'undergraduate'**, which starts with a vowel sound ('uh'). 
 
• In English, we use** 'an' **before words that start with a vowel sound. 

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is,:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Their"** (Option 1) is a possessive pronoun used to show ownership or association, and doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• **"A"** (Option 2) is an indefinite article used before words that begin with a consonant sound, not a vowel sound, so it is incorrect in this context.
 
• **"The" **(Option 4) is a definite article used to refer to specific or particular nouns, it would not be correct here because we are not referring to a specific undergraduate student, but any student who fits the description.
